CYAN: conversion flow PURPLE: state / reuse GRAY: model tasks AMBER: user action
C01–C05: configure, analyze and plan. C06–C10: reuse, convert, validate and package. S00–S05: durable information and external systems.
Deployment is a user action. Microservices call internal OpenShift Services; standalone packages call external URLs. Facts are disabled; source/AST analysis remains enabled.
Drill-down examples: “Expand C04 dependency closure”, “Expand C07 native conversion”, or “Expand S02 shared registries”.
